for: the citation lane -- its 95 pairs and this set are DIFFERENT SETS; sent so it does not re-derive
headline: CT.gov `type: DERIVED` means PubMed auto-linked the reference, INCLUDING a trial's own primary publication. It is UNINFORMATIVE, not reliable-in-one-direction. A rule that strips DERIVED-typed citations deletes CASTLE-AF (29385358), DAPA-HF (31535829) and COLCOT (31733140) -- all genuine primary reports.
reach_not_coverage: 22 stored citations were resolvable against evidence/2026-08-19-batch1/trial_citations_resolved.json, which holds 22 trials. This is the set THIS lane could resolve, not the corpus population.
finding: Both non-report citations sit in a field named `pmids_on_the_registration`, which accurately describes what it holds and claims nothing about authorship. On this evidence ZERO stored citations present a review as a trial's report.
